`monitorlizardskin` adds a monitor-lizard-style granular scaly skin, bringing the current catalog from 903 to 904 kinds (905 gallery choices including plain). A 14-column × 16-row hex-packed grid of round raised scales (odd rows shifted by half a column), each with its own tone (standard deviation about 0.09–0.10), slightly brighter and smoother, separated by narrow deep dark grooves (AO 0.4, color 0.04, roughness 0.7); four transverse light/dark bands undulate along v, in olive brown. It is not a specific species' scale shapes, size zones, spots or rings, and has no ventral scutes, dorsal crest or skin folds.

This material is an authored schematic of a generic coarse granular monitor-lizard skin. No specific source document, photograph or measurement is cited; the introduction of [Wikipedia “Monitor lizard”](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monitor_lizard) that I read describes genus, range and body size but not skin, so scale size, tones, bands, roughness, AO and the 0.14 m nominal tile are authored choices and do not claim to match any real species or specimen.

A dedicated sampler finds the nearest scale centre on a hex-packed grid (odd rows shifted by half a column, searching the row above, the row itself and the row below); scale = `smooth(1 − q/r²)` with r = 0.5, the hex Voronoi inradius, so a scale reaches zero before ownership changes (the per-scale tone lookup therefore creates no jump), with zero slope at the centre and rim. A 14×16 table (224 per-scale tone Float64 values) plus a 160² fine grain total 25,824 Float64 values / 206,592 B of lattice arithmetic (not total RAM). An even row count makes the stagger parity and the four transverse bands wrap with the tile. Metallic is 0 and there is no mortar; the default is a 0.14 m nominal tile and 0.01 UV-relative relief (not metres of displacement). I first tried radius 0.48 and a 0.9 vertical flattening, but flattening left non-zero jumps at the ownership boundary, so the final version is isotropic with radius 0.5. Measured at seeds 0/1/0xffffffff: scale-crown height 0.780–0.795 relief, AO 1, color 0.336–0.701 and roughness 0.550–0.609; the groove halfway to the same-row neighbour has height 0.08, AO 0.4, color 0.04 and roughness 0.7; per-scale tone standard deviation is 0.090–0.099. In the seed-7 512² maps mean r is 67.9, AO<180 covers 55.3%, r<50 covers 39.9% and the maximum normal tilt² is about 0.17. No new API or dependency; Worker/cache/texture ownership uses existing paths. This paragraph does not claim browser gallery verification.

`honduranmahogany` adds Honduran mahogany, bringing the current catalog from 901 to 902 kinds (903 gallery choices including plain). It approximates an unfinished longitudinal Swietenia macrophylla face: a fairly dark reddish brown, medium uniform texture, seven broad nearly straight low-contrast satin-like stripes (resembling quartersawn ribbon figure) and very sparse short open-vessel pits. The first version used a background weight of 0.02, which made edges extremely narrow (local slope about 7,700 per UV; the C1 sweep reached 0.035 against my 0.03 limit); with 0.25 the sweep maximum is ≤ 0.007. It approximates an unfinished Pinus palustris face: pale yellow-white earlywood with narrow high-contrast orange-brown latewood stripes in nearly parallel, gently undulating rings. It is not resin canals, knots, an all-reddish-brown heartwood face, a finish, or Douglas-fir-style large pointed arches.

Appearance follows the actually read [Wood Database Longleaf Pine](https://www.wood-database.com/longleaf-pine/) (Color/Appearance: reddish-brown heartwood and yellowish-white sapwood; Grain/Texture: straight, fine to medium; Endgrain: large, numerous, evenly distributed resin canals, abrupt earlywood-to-latewood transition and high color contrast) and the actually downloaded and viewed [wood-face photograph](https://www.wood-database.com/wp-content/uploads/longleaf-pine.jpg) (pale yellow-white ground with parallel orange-brown latewood stripes). These are color and stripe-shape references only: no source image is shipped and true color, roughness or physical size is not inferred from the photograph.

It reuses the `douglasfir` ring-index sampler by fallthrough; only the constructor selects the preset. More rings, a very small longitudinal arch and skew, a wider latewood darkening ramp and stronger latewood color difference produce nearly parallel stripes. The three constructor caches are a 5×5 warp, a 192×5 longitudinal fiber field and 128² grain (17,369 Float64 values / 138,952 B of lattice arithmetic, not total RAM). Metallic is 0 and there is no mortar; latewood is slightly raised and smoother and earlywood has slightly lower AO. The default 0.12 m nominal tile and 0.003 UV-relative relief (not metres of displacement) are authored choices. At seeds 0/1/0xffffffff on a 256² grid, color<0.4 latewood covers 21.1–24.0% and color>0.75 earlywood 52.7–55.9%, with an across/along color-difference ratio of 12.0–12.9 and latewood about 0.19 relief above earlywood; the seed-7 512² mean base color is about (232, 186, 125) and the maximum normal tilt² is about 0.030. No new API or dependency; Worker/cache/texture ownership uses existing paths. This paragraph does not claim browser gallery verification.

`douglasfir` adds flatsawn Douglas-fir, bringing the current catalog from 887 to 888 kinds (889 gallery choices including plain). It approximates an unfinished flatsawn longitudinal Pseudotsuga menziesii face: light orange-tan earlywood, darker orange-brown latewood growth rings, with multiple pointed cathedral arches around larger concentric ovals. It is not a knot, resin pocket or canal, sapwood/heartwood boundary, finished surface, or quartersawn straight parallel rings.

Appearance follows the actually read [Wood Database Douglas-Fir](https://www.wood-database.com/douglas-fir/) (Color/Appearance: light brown with a hint of red and/or yellow and darker growth rings, wild grain in flatsawn pieces; Grain/Texture: generally straight or slightly wavy, medium to coarse; Identification: small to medium, infrequent resin canals and an abrupt earlywood-to-latewood transition) and the actually downloaded and viewed [flatsawn specimen photograph](https://www.wood-database.com/wp-content/uploads/pseudotsuga-menziesii.jpg) (nested arched rings and one small knot). These are color and ring-shape references only: no source image is shipped, the knot is not reproduced, and true color, roughness or physical size is not inferred from the photograph.

A dedicated sampler (not a fallthrough to the vessel sampler) builds a smooth periodic ring-index field from cosine terms — a transverse term, a longitudinal arch term, an oblique skew and a seeded low-frequency warp — and takes fract() through a smoothstep ring profile whose value and slope are zero at both ends (a wide earlywood-to-latewood darkening followed by an abrupt return to earlywood), so the tile stays periodic and C1. Latewood is slightly raised and smoother; earlywood has slightly lower AO; metallic is 0 and there is no mortar. The three constructor caches are a 5×5 warp, a 160×5 longitudinal fiber field and 128² grain (17,209 Float64 values / 137,672 B of lattice arithmetic, not total RAM). The default 0.2 m nominal tile and 0.0035 UV-relative relief (not metres of displacement) are authored choices. At seeds 0/1/0xffffffff on a 256² grid, color<0.4 latewood covers 15.2% and color>0.75 earlywood 70.5–70.9%, with an across/along color-difference ratio of 2.95–3.09; the seed-7 512² mean base color is about (214, 165, 107) and the maximum normal tilt² is about 0.049. No new API or dependency; Worker/cache/texture ownership uses existing paths. This paragraph does not claim browser gallery verification.

`blackwalnut` adds a dark chocolate-brown black walnut flatsawn face, bringing the current catalog from 886 to 887 kinds (888 gallery choices including plain). It approximates an unfinished flatsawn longitudinal Juglans nigra heartwood face: medium-dark chocolate brown, darker long longitudinal streaks, straight to gently undulating grain and sparse short open-vessel pits. It is not purple/grey cast, sapwood, curl/burl/birdseye/crotch figure or a finished surface, and it has no semi-ring-porous earlywood-to-latewood vessel-size gradient: the pits are uniform stylized marks.

Appearance follows the actually read [Wood Database Black Walnut](https://www.wood-database.com/black-walnut/) (Color/Appearance: pale to dark chocolate brown with darker streaks; Grain/Texture: usually straight but can be irregular, medium texture, moderate natural luster; Porosity: semi-ring-porous) and the actually downloaded and viewed [flatsawn full-board scan](https://www.wood-database.com/wp-content/uploads/juglans-nigra-full.jpg). They are color and grain-direction references only: no source image is shipped, and true color, roughness or physical size is not inferred from the photograph.

It reuses the existing Padauk/Bloodwood-family long elliptical vessel sampler by fallthrough; only the constructor selects the preset: a 40×14 vessel-site table (four Float64 per site, 17,920 B), four warped bands, a 192×9 longitudinal fiber field and 128² fine grain. Metallic is 0 and AO drops only at vessels; the pits are real height depressions while longitudinal color streaks are pigment, not raised relief. The default 0.16 m nominal tile and 0.0025 UV-relative relief (not metres of displacement) are authored choices. At seeds 0/1/0xffffffff on a 256² grid, vessels cover 0.54–0.59%, body color spans 0.254–0.579, and across/along color-difference ratio is 8.8–10.0; the seed-7 512² mean base color is about (86, 59, 40). No new API or dependency; Worker/cache/texture ownership uses existing paths. This paragraph does not claim browser gallery verification.

`to92packagefaces` adds four rotated/jittered 2×2 TO-92 front schematics, bringing the current catalog from 885 to 886 kinds (887 gallery choices including plain). Matte-black D-shaped bodies have straight sides, flat bottoms and upper elliptical domes; three equally spaced parallel straight neutral-metal leads have broad root shoulders and narrow tails, with roots masked by the body. No exposed tab, mounting hole or markings are drawn. Full leads have M1; body/backing have M0, with C1 boundary blends. Authored normalized heights are backing .02 < lead .44 < body .68.

The dimension reference is the actually downloaded and raster-viewed [onsemi P2N2222A/D, January 2013 Rev. 7, PDF page 6](https://www.onsemi.com/pdf/datasheet/p2n2222a-d.pdf#page=6): embedded drawing 98ASB42022B, TO-92 (TO-226), CASE 29-11, Issue AM, dated 09 MAR 2007, drawing page 1 of 2, STRAIGHT LEAD BULK PACK view. Its A 4.45–5.20 mm, B 4.32–5.33 mm, G 1.15–1.39 mm and K ≥12.70 mm are dimension references only, not measurements of the artwork. The upper half ellipse, proportions, shoulders, color, roughness, AO and heights are authored simplifications, not exact CAD. No chemistry, plating, optical or electrical properties are inferred; no source artwork is shipped.

Defaults are a 0.08 m nominal tile, 0.0042 UV-relative relief (not metres of displacement) and metallic factor 1. Explicit `createMaterial({ metallic: 0 })` changes only the scalar factor, not the stored M mask. The TO-220 constructor-cached pose/grain and C1 role-replacement structure is reused, preserving periodic opaque maps, optional height, tint/repeats, Worker/cache APIs and texture ownership without new APIs or dependencies. Remove borrowed materials before destroying the texture-owning preset; manage caller-owned pools/caches separately. Prefer 512 for the three narrow tails; 32 is a coarse preview. This description does not claim runtime/browser verification.

`ftypefemalefaces` adds four 2×2 bare F-type female bulkhead front schematics, bringing the catalog from 883 to 884 kinds: six-flat nickel-plated metal hex bases, concentric raised round shoulders, CLOSED unkeyed raised circular lips, pale P.P. dielectric disks and tiny deeper dark opaque central female entries. Exterior hardware has M1; backing, P.P. and entries have M0. Authored normalized height order is backing .02 < entry .06 < nut .26 < shoulder .36 < P.P. .48 < lip .66. The entry is a height depression, not a painted dot; pale P.P. remains continuous around it. Unlike ST, there is no open keyway or bayonet stud, and no male pin or invented visible central metal contact ring.

The primary reference is the actually downloaded and raster-viewed historical [Amphenol Connex CAT-103 ©2001 catalog, PDF page 159 / printed page 158](https://docs.rs-online.com/1ab7/A700000006717073.pdf#page=159): the 222121 BULKHEAD ADAPTER JACK-TO-JACK photograph, drawing and model-specific Nickel / P.P. / 75Ω table. Generic Delrin/Teflon notes elsewhere do not override this model's P.P.; neither base-alloy chemistry nor exact contact material is inferred. The drawing's 11 HEX and 21.3 mm axial overall length are references, not measured front geometry; washer/nut side dimensions are not front height. The tiny actual entry cross-section is unresolved at source-photo resolution: its circular form here is a deliberate artist simplification, not exact CAD. Proportions, color, roughness, AO, layer heights, default 0.04 m tile and 0.0042 UV-relief factor are authored; .0042 is not metres or a calibrated depth. No thread helix/decorative thread turns, washer teeth, rear/cable/PCB, real holes, transparency or new mesh; no RF/75Ω, electrical, optical, mating or safety simulation/certification. Historical 75Ω identifies the part only. Source assets are not bundled; this extends the existing `pbr3d` gallery, not a new examples entry.

The independent 46-field preset (44 numeric fields and two palettes) uses ten C1 profiles: six smooth hex half-planes and four squared-radius circle profiles. Nested convex role replacement and 20 constructor-cached C/H/R/AO deltas avoid nonzero hard-min/max joins. Four four-column Float64 poses (128 B) plus 96² Float64 grain (73,728 B) retain 73,856 B typed-array payload, excluding JS object/closure overhead—not total RAM, FPS or a performance improvement claim. The rotation-independent owner bound, maxScale × nutInradius / (sqrt(3)/2) + jitter, is approximately .369958 < .5. Constructor-cached poses/grain leave no query allocation, loop, hash, trigonometry or square root; zero support and unused grain on full P.P./entry/backing are skipped. The second fractional wrap before owner indexing is retained for tiny negative UVs. Default metallic is 1; explicit `createMaterial({ metallic: 0 })` changes only the factor, not the stored hardware/nonmetal mask. Existing opaque four maps, optional height, tint/repeats and sync/Worker/cache APIs and ownership remain unchanged: remove borrowing materials before disposing the texture-owning preset, and manage caller-owned pools/caches separately. No new dependency or API. These are source/implementation descriptions, not full-suite, runtime, browser or built-distribution verification claims.

`rcafemalefaces` adds four 2×2 RCA/Cinch female-face schematics: broad round black insulating washers, smaller round metal shoulders, still smaller six-flat front barrel noses, dark annular insulators and deep round bores with simplified recessed conductive socket annuli and dark opaque floors. There are no BNC bayonet lugs, male center pins or large rear mounting nuts on the front. This is a connector-family variation, not new rendering or connector-simulation technology. The catalog then contained 879 kinds.

Appearance references actually read/viewed: the primary [REAN NYS367-0 drawing](https://www.rean-connectors.com/media/14879/download/NYS367-0.pdf?v=1), drawing 3.652.052 dated 2020-11-13, and the generic [NYS367 product PDF](https://www.rean-connectors.com/en/product/nys367-1.pdf). The drawing labels washer Ø15.5, barrel Ø8.3, front length 7.5, M8×0.75 and overall (29); AF12 describes the large rear nut, not a front measurement. Its inconsistent NYS373-x note is not evidence for a new variant, and the product PDF URL is not evidence of a NYS367-1 variant. Product photographs show the small front flats, wider washer and rear nut/lug; the PDF lists brass/gold housing, nut, lug and pin and PA+30%GF washer, not a specified inner dielectric resin. Neutral gray deliberately omits real gold optics; all shapes, positions, relief, palette, roughness and the 0.04 m nominal tile / 0.0042 UV relief are authored approximations, not measured CAD, tolerances or a hidden cross-section.

The independent 56-field preset/kernel combines six radial squared-distance C1 profiles with three smooth folded hex slabs and 27 cached channel deltas. Four four-column poses (128 B) and 96² Float64 grain (73,728 B) retain 73,856 typed-array payload bytes, not total RAM or FPS. Sampling uses no per-point allocation, hash, trigonometry, square root or per-side loop; `Math.sqrt(3) / 2` is evaluated only at construction. Default metallic 1 retains metal shoulders/barrels/socket contacts and nonmetallic washers/insulators/floors; explicit 0 changes the material factor, not the stored map. Existing opaque four maps, optional height, tint/repeats, synchronous/module Worker pool/cache paths and preset-owned texture cleanup remain unchanged, as do all previous 878 kinds. No new dependency or API entry point is added. Prefer 512; 32 is a coarse preview that need not resolve the small socket. No rear nut/lug/solder tails, actual threads or spring split, panel/PCB geometry, mesh, through-hole transparency, collision, electrical/audio/RF/fit/EMC/safety simulation or certification is provided.

`rj45femalefaces` adds four schematic RJ45-type 8P8C female faces: thin rectangular metal shields surround matte-black insulating liners; low main wells join narrower stepped latch extensions on one side, with single rows of eight isolated long metal fingers opposite. This differs from nine four-contact `rectangularsocketfaces` and USB-C's two-row 24-pad tongues, not merely a recolor or new technology category. The actually read [TE 1734795-6 product page](https://www.te.com/en/product-1734795-6.html) specifies eight positions/eight loaded contacts, no indicator, black PA9T GF30, gold/nickel-plated phosphor-bronze contacts and nickel-plated brass shells. Neutral gray omits gold-plating optics; the step, pad layout, dimensions, depths, colors, PBR roughness and 0.054 m nominal tile/0.0044 UV relief are authored approximations, not exact CAD or a reproduction of a manufacturer mechanical drawing.

The independent 55-field kernel caches fifteen channel deltas and five squared-distance C1 profiles (outer/liner/main/key/pin); main + key − main × key joins the wells without a max seam. Queries select one nearest contact candidate without a per-pad loop, arrays, hash, trigonometry or square root. Four four-column poses (128 B) plus 96² Float64 grain (73,728 B) retain 73,856 B typed payload, not total RAM or FPS. Default metallic 1 preserves M1 shields/fingers and M0 insulation/floors; explicit 0 changes the factor, not the stored map. Existing opaque four maps, optional height, tint/repeats, Worker pool/cache and texture ownership remain unchanged, as do the previous 877 kinds. No new dependency, LEDs, plug/wires, magnetics, PCB/solder tails or panel EMI tabs; no cavity mesh, Ethernet/PoE/Cat/speed/electrical/EMC/safety simulation or mating certification.

`usbcfemalefaces` adds four schematic USB-C female faces: rounded-flat metal mouths, recessed matte-dark wells, thin central insulating tongues and two rows of twelve metal pads per face (24 total), distinct from the existing nine four-contact `rectangularsocketfaces`, not a new technology category. The actually viewed [GCT USB4050 drawing](https://gct.co/files/drawings/usb4050.pdf), dated 2016-04-21, revision C (2023-06-29), is stamped OBSOLETE, not evidence of current availability or certification. It specifies black high-temperature plastic without a resin identification; neutral-gray metal omits actual gold-plating optics. Rounded-flat mouths are not exact capsules; side grounds/latches, stacked shells and PCB tails are omitted.

The independent kernel uses 50 preset fields, fifteen cached channel deltas, four squared-distance profiles and one nearest contact candidate. Four poses (128 B) plus 96² periodic grain (73,728 B) retain 73,856 B typed-array storage, not measured total RAM or FPS. Point sampling uses no arrays, hash, trigonometry or square root; old kernels gain no sampling work. Default metallic 1 preserves M1 mouths/pads and M0 insulation/floors; explicit 0 changes the factor, not the stored map. The 0.032 m nominal tile and 0.0045 UV relief are authored approximations, not calibrated mating dimensions. Opaque height/normal shading is not a cavity mesh, CAD, electrical/USB speed/PD/safety simulation or certification. Existing four maps, optional height, tint/repeats, Worker/cache and texture ownership remain unchanged; no new backend certification or runtime dependency is added.

`iecc6inlets` adds four schematic IEC C6 male inlet faces: flat black-PA6 rounded rectangular flanges surround one shared upper-single/lower-pair cloverleaf well, three solid round metal contact tips and two wide countersunk mounting depressions. Tips rise above the floor but remain below the flange; there is no raised C8 guard. The official PDF returned 403; pages 1/2 of the [RS-hosted original three-page SCHURTER 2561 datasheet](https://docs.rs-online.com/a592/0900766b814421a9.pdf), dated 2015-04-22, were downloaded, rendered and magnified to inspect its photograph/front elevation and C6, black PA6 and solid-turned-contact descriptions. The front drawing has a 37×19 mm/R4 flange, 28 mm mounting pitch and Ø3.2 bores/Ø6.4 countersinks; 18 mm is side-view depth, not front height. Flange, shared well, countersinks and opaque mounting-hole floors share one PA6 albedo, with height/AO shading. Only the three simplified visible tips are M1; no alloy/plating is inferred. Concentric contact bases, markings, rear terminals, shaft lengths and protective-earth sequencing are omitted. This is not C5 female sockets, C14 blades, geometric through-holes, mains simulation or IEC/safety certification.

The independent kernel uses 47 preset fields, seventeen constructor-cached channel deltas and five squared-profile coefficient groups. Four centers/scaled rotation bases retain 128 B plus 73,728 B of 96² periodic grain: 73,856 B typed storage, not total RAM or FPS. The owner bound hypot(.37,.19)+.016 < .431933 < .5 permits one floor per coordinate and one owner. Six profile candidates cover the rounded flange, countersink, bore, upper lobe, absolute-x lower lobe and nearest circular contact. A C1 union connects the upper/lower lobes; lower supports vanish around the fold, and all three contact supports vanish before nearest-center bisectors. Counter-annulus, well-bounding-box and outer-contact returns avoid unnecessary work. Queries allocate nothing and use no hash, trigonometry, square root, per-contact or neighbor loop. Before/after optimization, 24,576 signed samples/147,456 channel values and six five-map sets were exactly identical. Default metallic 1 preserves M1 tips/M0 polymer; explicit 0 only changes the factor. The .1 m nominal tile, .0045 UV normal relief and smooth cloverleaf/bowls are authored approximations, not calibrated CAD, contact depths or material measurements. Opaque maps, optional height, tint/repeats/Worker/cache and texture ownership retain existing contracts without new public entry points or runtime dependencies.

`iecc8inlets` adds four schematic IEC C8 male inlet faces: black PA6 rounded rectangular flanges carry raised capsule-shaped shrouds, semicircular well ends and symmetric rounded-V upper/lower waists forming one shared figure-eight cavity. Two solid round metal contact tips rise above each low floor but remain below the guard. The [SCHURTER 2572 page](https://www.schurter.com/en/datasheet/2572) was read for C8, PA6 and solid-contact descriptions. Official PDF/JPEG assets returned 403; pages 1/3 of the [TME-hosted original 2023 five-page datasheet](https://www.tme.eu/Document/3aea005c480575d6ca262e097188b992/6160.0008.pdf) were actually downloaded, rendered and magnified to inspect the photograph and front elevation. This is not two overlapping circular bores, a C7 female socket, three C14 blades or a polarized outline. Flange, shroud, waist and opaque floor share black-PA6 albedo with height/AO shading; only the two simplified visible tips are M1, without asserting alloy/plating. Concentric or toothed contact bases, small molded recesses, markings and rear terminals are omitted; no geometric through-hole, mains simulation or IEC/safety certification.

The independent kernel caches 44 preset fields, fourteen fixed channel deltas and squared-profile coefficients at construction. Four scaled rotation bases/centers retain 128 B plus 73,728 B of 96² periodic grain: 73,856 B typed storage, not total RAM or FPS. The per-coordinate owner bound hypot(.29,.1814)+.016 < .358062 < .5; each coordinate is floored once and only one cell is sampled. Five C1 profiles cover the rounded rectangle, outer capsule, inner capsule, mirrored rounded-V implicit hyperbola and circular pin. The hyperbolic waist is an authored smooth approximation, not calibrated manufacturer curvature. A single absolute-x pin candidate has zero support around its fold; the capsule shares its pin-x difference and squared-y calculation. Queries allocate nothing and use no hash, trigonometry, square root, per-pin or neighbor loop. Default metallic 1 preserves M1 tips/M0 polymer; explicit 0 changes only the factor, not maps. The .08 m nominal tile and .0045 UV normal relief are authored, not calibrated 22.7×14.2 mm drawing scale, depth or material measurements. Existing opaque four-map/optional-height, tint/repeats, Worker/cache and texture ownership contracts remain unchanged, without new entry points or runtime dependencies.

`din5femalefaces` adds four schematic standard five-pin DIN female faces: black PBT rounded rectangular flanges have three mounting openings (upper center and lower pair), closed raised circular mouths, keyed upper insert cutouts and lower structural webs. Five elongated, centrally bulged recessed mouths form an upper pair, lower pair and bottom center on an approximate lower semicircle; this is not mini-DIN. The [Same Sky SDS-50J product page](https://www.sameskydevices.com/product/interconnect/connectors/din-connectors/sds-50j) identifies standard DIN, five contacts, the 180° family and no shielding. The [matching photograph](https://cdn.sameskydevices.com/products/image/getproductimage/1184?typecode=m&width=300) and lower SDS-50J drawing/material table on page 3 of the six-page [manufacturer drawing](https://www.sameskydevices.com/product/resource/sds-j.pdf) were viewed, without borrowing the upper SDS-40J table. It specifies black PBT housing, copper/tin phosphor-bronze ground/terminals and a PE cover whose plating/color cell is blank; terminal plating is not assigned to plastic. Visible PBT shares albedo, with height/AO supplying relief shading. M0 opaque mouth floors stand in for unresolved interiors, not plastic real contacts or a wholly metal-free connector. Lower metal hardware/small housing notches, PCB/rear terminals, internal contact springs, lettering and pin numbers are omitted; no transparent geometric holes, MIDI/audio/electrical simulation or standards certification.

The independent kernel retains four centers/scaled rotation bases (128B) and 96² periodic grain (73,728B), totaling 73,856B typed storage, not total RAM or FPS. Its 72 preset fields and seventeen cached channel deltas follow existing compact-C1 conventions. The owner bound hypot(.25,.264) + .016 = .379588 stays below .5; the five-mouth support bound .131170 stays within the .145 insert full core. A y-half/absolute fold selects one of three mounting holes. Elongated mouth projections overlap ordinary rows, so row-center or absolute-x cuts are insufficient: constructor-cached projections of the complete rounded-slot and central-bulge supports place two separators in .022493/.024068 zero-support gaps, retaining one mouth candidate per query. Slot/bulge C1 union, upper cutouts and cavity-weighted lower webs remain C1. Nine primitives floor each owner coordinate once, with no query allocation, hash, trig, square root, per-hole or neighbor loop. All visible faces and unresolved floors are M0, with default metallic 0; an explicit factor does not turn blue-zero maps metallic. The .08 m nominal tile and .0045 UV normal relief are authored, not drawing scale, bore-depth or measured-material calibration. Five opaque maps reuse existing Worker/cache/texture ownership without runtime dependencies.

`xlrfemalefaces` adds four schematic three-pole XLR female mating faces: rounded rectangular D-size metal flanges have two genuine front upper-left/lower-right mounting holes, closed raised circular mouths, raised black inserts, top release latches and internal metal tabs. Thin inner metal collars remain open at the top; three recessed female mouths form an upper pair and one lower center. The [Neutrik NC3FD-LX material table](https://www.neutrik.com/en/product/nc3fd-lx) was read, and the [matching manufacturer photograph](https://www.neutrik.com/uploads/media/400x/00/540-nc3fd-lx.jpg?v=1-0) and page 1 of the [original drawing](https://www.neutrik.com/media/8412/download/nc3fd-lx-3.pdf?v=1) were viewed, distinguishing front/rear views and circular embossings from the two real holes. D-size denotes a mounting family, not a D-shaped front outline. The table specifies nickel-plated ZnAl4Cu1 diecast shell, PA66 insert, CuSn6 contacts with 2μm Ag and nickel-plated Ck67 locking element; no PA66 glass-fill percentage or electrical role for the small tab is inferred. Visible metal shares neutral-gray albedo, with height/AO supplying relief shading. Lettering, pin numbers, rear solder cups, internal contact cage and silver-plating spectra are omitted. M0 low mouth floors are opaque unresolved-interior stand-ins, not a claim that real contacts are plastic; no male pins, transparent geometric holes or audio/electrical simulation.

The independent kernel follows cached-pose, periodic-grain and compact-C1 conventions: four centers/scaled rotation bases retain 128B plus 73,728B of 96² grain, totaling 73,856B typed storage, not total RAM or FPS. The conservative flange owner bound is hypot(0.29, 0.345) × 1 + 0.018 = 0.468694 < 0.5; the tab bound hypot(0.043, 0.159) = 0.164712 stays within the 0.175 insert and 0.176 collar-void full cores. Thirty fixed channel deltas are cached. Each owner coordinate is floored once; the y-half mount fold and row/absolute socket fold each select one candidate, without per-hole or neighbor loops. Squared radial, rounded-rectangle and narrow-gap supports remain C1; the gap's midline switch has only zero-weight support inside the collar void, whose full interior skips unnecessary collar primitives. Removing two fully masked prototype gap controls preserves all 147,456 channels of 24,576 three-seed samples and thirty 32/512 packed buffers exactly; this is not FPS evidence. Queries allocate nothing and perform no hash, trig or square root. Default metallic 1 preserves visible M1 metal and M0 insert/opaque floors/backing; explicit 0 changes only the factor. The 0.09 m nominal tile and 0.0045 UV normal relief are authored, not manufacturing dimensions, bore depths or plating calibration. All five maps are opaque and reuse existing Worker, cache and texture ownership without runtime dependencies.

`bncfemalefaces` adds four schematic BNC female mating faces: low round metal flanges carry raised circular barrel rims, two opposed bayonet studs below each rim, inner metal walls and white dielectric annuli. A simplified central metal ring surrounds an opaque low socket floor, not a projecting male pin. The [matched TTI 031-221-RFX listing](https://www.tti.com/content/ttiinc/en/apps/part-detail.html?partsNumber=031-221-RFX&mfgShortname=ACO), its linked [original Amphenol drawing](https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/catsy.582/C31-221-RFX.pdf) and a [matching photograph](https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/catsy.582/031-221-RFX_1.jpg) were read/viewed. The supplied drawing is one PDF page marked sheet 2/3, not a verified complete three-sheet set; its notes specify nickel-plated zinc-diecast body, gold-plated phosphor-bronze contact and natural Delrin insulation, not the non-RFX variant or PTFE. One shared neutral-gray albedo covers the nickel body; height/AO supply recess shading. Gold spectra, contact slots/spring fingers, rear threads, separate nuts/washers/tags, lettering, geometric through-holes and RF/impedance simulation are omitted. The M0 low floor is an opaque stand-in for unresolved interiors, not a claim about the real hole-bottom material.

The independent kernel follows cached-pose, periodic-grain and compact-C1 conventions: four centers/scaled rotation bases retain 128B plus 73,728B of 96² grain, totaling 73,856B typed storage, not total RAM or FPS. The outer-flange owner bound is 0.36 × 1 + 0.018 = 0.378 < 0.5; the stud bound hypot(0.332, 0.028) = 0.333179 is below the 0.35 flange full-core radius, and all concentric layers nest inside previous full cores. Squared radial/rounded-rectangle supports and an absolute-coordinate fold select one stud candidate; smooth body-priority weights avoid a hard max. Twenty-five fixed channel deltas are cached in the constructor. Each owner coordinate is floored once; absent body/stud and inner supports return early. Queries allocate nothing and perform no hash, trig or square root. Default metallic 1 retains M1 flange/barrel/studs/inner wall/contact and M0 dielectric/opaque floor/backing; explicit 0 changes only the factor. The 0.04 m nominal tile and 0.0045 UV normal relief are authored, not manufacturing dimensions or calibrated depths. All five maps are opaque and reuse existing Worker, cache and texture ownership without runtime dependencies.

`iecc14inlets` adds four schematic IEC C14 male inlet faces: black dielectric rectangular shrouds enclose low keyed cavities with two symmetric upper clipped corners and one centered upper metal blade cap above a level lower pair. Solid blade ends rise from the cavity floor but stay below the protective rim. The [SCHURTER 6100-4 page](https://www.schurter.com/en/datasheet/6100-4) was read, and pages 1/2 of the [third-party-hosted original 2017 datasheet](https://eu.components-store.com/datasheets/86/6100.4225.pdf) were rendered and viewed: despite its 4225 filename, it covers the family including the 6100.4215 1.5 mm snap-in/4.8×0.8 mm rear-terminal option, and separates solid front tips from perforated rear quick-connect tabs. The independent kernel follows cached-pose, periodic-grain and compact-C1 conventions: 128B poses plus 73,728B of 96² grain retain 73,856B typed storage, not total RAM or FPS. `radiolariandiscs` adds four authored radiolarian equatorial cutaways: four concentric ivory mineral rings enclose a central chamber and three annular rows of 6/12/18 chambers, 37 dark closed chambers per disc, with six smoothly tapering short marginal spines. Skeletons are raised, brighter and smoother than the low rough occluded dark backing; seeds vary placement, orientation, scale and microfinish. These are skeletal equatorial sections, not external porous sieve plates, fixed-count through-going `spiderweb` spokes, flush `orbicularjasper`/`thomsonite` pigment bands or lanceolate `diatomvalves` striae. The actually read [Haeckel Discoidea overview and Stylodictya entries](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Report_on_the_Radiolaria/Discoidea), [Plate 41 legends](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Report_on_the_Radiolaria/Plates5) and actually viewed Plate 41 distinguish figures 2/3/6/7 as rings alone/equatorial sections from complete sieve-covered faces. Four rings, 6/12/18 chambers and six short spines are simplified author choices, not an identified species, modern taxonomy, complete cell, calibrated microscopy or silica optics; no source image is copied or bundled.

`bgasolderballs` adds schematic unmounted BGA undersides: four raised dark square dielectric carriers each hold a complete, uniformly pitched 13 × 13 field of equal-sized silver metallic rounded domes, 676 balls in total. Balls rise brighter and smoother above the carrier with occluded contact bands; seeds change whole-package placement/orientation and microfinish, not manufacturing-grid regularity. This is distinct from the two external lead rows of `dualinlinechips`, annular `ballbearingfaces`, connected `ballchain` and dielectric `lensarray`. An independent 768² raw-surface fixture finds carriers by dielectric-height separation and balls by eight-connected metallic > 0.5 masks, without pose tables, seed phases or nearest-grid equations. Observed nearest-center distances and a fourth angular harmonic recover pitch/orthogonal axes; independently clustered projections verify every row/column population and unique cell. Local peak refinement and twelve-direction probes compare tops, midprofiles, contacts and carriers. Outer probes use min(1.5 × observed ball radius, observed nearest pitch / 2), avoiding a neighboring ball in valid dense 17 × 17 grids. All three seeds yield four carriers/676 balls/no orphans; every carrier has 13 × 13 levels, 169 unique cells and 13 balls per row/column. Area CV ≤0.023033, pitch CV ≤0.002442, axis-pitch ratio 0.999833–1.000218, fourth-harmonic strength ≥0.999379, lattice residual ≤0.014079 pitch and centering error ≤0.000217 equivalent carrier radii. Raw normalized ball rise/pigment contrast/finish contrast/carrier elevation are ≥0.549037/0.691606/0.543080/0.220260; center-to-midprofile drop ≥0.207058, midprofile elevation ≥0.318149 and contact-AO contrast ≥0.219584. Peaks retain M1 and carrier rings M0. Actual seeded metal-footprint changes are 0.116089/0.112793. C1 residual ≤0.002491 and signed-UV periodic error ≤1.49e-14; 32/512 maps are opaque with positive Z and XYZ squared-length error ≤0.012888. The 0.001 tilt² threshold exceeds flat encoded quantization. At 512, M0/M1/transition counts are 240518/17067/4559; 32 is coarse preview, not individual-ball certification. Forty-five valid variants each pass fifteen cases, including even 12 and 11/15/17 grids, one/nine carriers, independent AO, no grain height, C2 compact cubic domes, hemisphere profiles with C1 contact blending and quintic shoulders. Twenty-two executable faults are rejected, none accepted; only AssertionErrors count, covering missing-center/perimeter-only arrays, staggered/nonuniform/nonorthogonal lattices, unequal diameters, flat pads/recesses, missing carriers/rise/pigment/finish/contact, wrong metal regions, hard/linear shoulders, finish-only seeds and owner clipping.

`pigskinleather` adds warm-brown matte skin with 64 irregular triangular follicle triplets: each group contains three separate rounded pits whose centers are lower, darker, rougher and occluded. Seeds vary group placement/orientation/radius and individual pore size/ellipse orientation. The arrangement is triangular, not each individual pore. It is distinct from existing Voronoi-pebbled `leather`, single raised quill collars in `ostrichleather`, hairy `cowhide` patches and the equal-sized single staggered perforations of `perforatedleather`. References actually read are [Etherington and Roberts' conservation dictionary, pigskin](https://cool.culturalheritage.org/don/dt/dt2578.html), [Kawanishi Kaban's ∴ identification paragraph](https://shop.kawanishikaban.com/en/blogs/%E7%B4%A0%E6%9D%90%E3%81%AB%E3%81%A4%E3%81%84%E3%81%A6/material-pigskin), and the [Leather Repair Company pigskin entry](https://prorestorers.co.uk/knowledgebase/pig-leather-skin/). Two 300px close-ups from the latter were viewed, but are not used to certify every triplet visually. The dictionary's roughly triangular groups of three inform an authored motif, not authenticity, breed, tanning, Nappa grading or pore-density certification. Existing cached-noise, compact C1 cavity and single-owner table patterns are reused: three bounded elliptical pits over continuous two-scale grain, not a new general leather API. The 192 × 5 center/quadratic coefficients plus 64² + 128² grain values retain 171,520 typed bytes, excluding JS objects, output maps and total RAM. Sampling visits exactly three pores without allocation, hashing, square roots, trigonometry or neighbor scanning. Default per-axis support is bounded by 0.426782 < 0.5, while within-triplet pore-center distance ≤0.250337 remains below the inter-triplet lower bound 0.272686. The nominal 0.028 m tile and relief 0.0038 UV units are authored, not measured pore depth. Opaque dielectric maps do not reconstruct through-dermis follicles, the flesh side, wrinkle networks, breathability or transmission.

Recess depth/color/roughness/AO contrasts are respectively ≥0.327798/0.469495/0.207435/0.629999, with metallic and mortar both zero; seed footprint changes are 0.017761/0.018494. C1 residual is ≤0.00004552 and signed-UV error ≤5.56e-16. Both 32/512 outputs remain opaque/M0/positive-Z with XYZ squared-length error ≤0.009935. The final matrix passes 32 legal variants × 15 cases and rejects 20 executable faults, with zero accepted and only AssertionErrors counted: four/six-sided or curved drives, painted/raised/backing-height floors, missing pigment/AO/finish, fixed stamps, nonmetal/grout floors, hard/linear/minimum-corner creases and owner clipping.

`diatomvalves` depicts four seeded ivory, lanceolate external valve motifs: apically elongated lineolae form paired transapical striae around an expanded, flush central clear area, while two raphes remain separated centrally and bend slightly toward the same side near their tips. The axial sternum rises slightly; pores and fissures are lower, darker, rougher and occluded, not eight chiton plates, guard-cell rings or deep internal-valve chambers. References actually read include the [Diatoms of North America Navicula guide](https://diatoms.org/genera/navicula/guide), [N. tripunctata external/internal SEM metadata](https://diatoms.org/species/navicula_tripunctata/images), and the morphology section/caption of [Yılmaz et al. (2024), Fig.3](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11019260/). Both tripunctata SEM views and Fig.3 were actually viewed: A–D are external, E–H internal; internal grooves/helictoglossae are not copied onto the outer face. This is an authored naviculoid motif, not a species reconstruction, SEM gold coating, live cell or complete paired frustule. The 0.00012 m tile, 2² layout, ivory palette and exaggerated normal-authoring relief 0.0022 are not calibrated pore density, shell thickness or reflectance. Existing cached poses, C1 compact support and grain support bounded nearest-row/column lookup of one lineola; construction retains four poses, 24 row bounds and 96² grain, totaling 160 + 768 + 73,728 = 74,656 typed bytes, excluding JS/output maps and without claiming an fps gain. Whole aperture supports stay outside the central clear area instead of per-pixel clipping into split fragments. Default radius plus jitter is 0.47070 < 0.5 cell; row/column switches occur outside aperture support. Sampling allocates nothing and uses no hash, sqrt, trig, neighboring-cell or per-pore scan. Fully opaque M0 cavities retain solid backing; no geometry, transparency/transmission, full girdle/internal valve, photonics, locomotion or biological model is added.

Diagnostics use max(768, 384 × cells) samples per axis and eight-connected regions. All three default 768² seeds yield four footprints, each with two raphes and 84 lineolae in 22 transapical groups: observed results, not taxonomic pore counts or pinned fixture constants. Centroids/covariances recover axes and four first-exit contours measure dimensions; bilateral local color contrast identifies cavities without reading pose/row tables, copying the shape equation or assuming a fixed color/height-drop ratio. Median lineola axis ratio is ≥2.3239, same-side row-spacing CV ≤0.03686, with no central lineolae. The observed raphe gap is 0.08164–0.08379 of valve length, and same-sided tip deflection ≥0.01498 of width. Median raw color/normalized height/roughness/AO cavity gaps are ≥0.61967/0.29991/0.27971/0.52. Footprint radius CV ≥0.05494, position SD ≥0.01670, orientation concentration ≤0.3541 and seed footprint changes 0.10254/0.10767 distinguish geometry from pigment noise. C1 residual ≤0.014712 and signed-UV difference ≤1.95e-14. Fifty-two legal variants pass 15 cases each, including independent pore pigment/depth, shorter bodies, different rows, quintic shoulders and elliptic outlines. Twenty-four executable faults are rejected, none accepted: circular/transverse holes, missing clear center, fused raphes, opposite bends, absent depth/finish/AO, one-sided pores, irregular rows, fixed stamps, actual owner clipping, hard/linear shoulders and metallic valves. Actual 32/512 RGBA remain M0, opaque and positive-Z with XYZ unit error ≤0.010058; 32 is coarse preview, not pore/raphe or species certification.

`chitonshells` adds nine elongated oval dorsal motifs, each with eight raised valves (two terminal caps and six intermediate plates), seven directionally asymmetric lap shoulders and a darker, rougher mantle girdle around the shell core. Exposed faces rise in the lap direction beneath a low rounded midline ridge; a continuous lower, darker, occluded shell underface remains at the seams, rather than merely incising seven symmetric lines into one oval. [UCMP Polyplacophora](https://ucmp.berkeley.edu/taxa/inverts/mollusca/polyplacophora.php), including the actually viewed Lined Chiton photograph/anatomy diagram, informs the eight dorsal plates and girdle. The actually viewed dorsal/side SEM in [Connors et al. (2019), Fig. 1a–b](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6904579/) distinguishes the eight primary plates from the peripheral small scales. This preset only grains the girdle; it does not reconstruct that paper's hundreds of scales or μ-CT geometry. The warm-brown palette, 0.12 m tile and 3² layout are authored illustration, not grayscale-SEM color recovery, a particular species or calibrated biological scale. Existing compact squared ellipse shoulders and C1 corner-ramp conventions form rounded-absolute chevrons. One owner and one active course suffice, without scanning eight plates per pixel. The constructor precomputes hashes, rotation/scale bases, plate tones and 96² grain; poses/tones 864 B + grain 73,728 B retain 74,592 B of typed storage, excluding JS/output maps and not proving higher fps. Default maximal rotated radius plus jitter is 0.47335 < 0.5. Curved coordinates can extend beyond the last interval inside the tail cap: retain its last valve rather than read the next owner's tone or undefined. The field hot path has no allocation, hashing, square roots or trigonometry; shoulders and ramps remain C1. This fully opaque dielectric 2D relief does not create hidden overlap volumes, eight articulated meshes, rolling motion, shell-eye optics, transmission/SSS, shell-layer/muscle anatomy or biomechanics.

Diagnostics use max(512, 256 × cells) samples per axis: all three default seeds at 768² have nine four-connected footprints and 72 raised faces, with exactly eight principal-axis face intervals per body, not separate meshes. Footprint centroids/covariances recover axes; observed valleys and half-height crossings measure seven consistent lap directions, long/short shoulder ratio ≥3.3881 and forward height rise ≥0.06946 on the six middle plates. Valleys lie ≥0.3910 below adjacent peaks yet ≥0.1542 above the girdle upper bound, with an AO gap of about 0.21. Independently tracked lateral valleys recover rounded-chevron shift ≥0.3020 pitch and bilateral difference ≤0.00280. All 32 radial probes per body retain a girdle, with relative width ≥0.1796 and plate/girdle roughness gap ≥0.3752. Footprint radius CV ≥0.03553, position SD ≥0.02148 and orientation concentration ≤0.4280; changed-seed footprint classifications differ by 0.11401/0.11646. C1 residual ≤0.000383 and signed UV difference ≤2.45e-15. RGBA checks use the actual 32/512 grids; phase segmentation is only performed at 512 using sampled raw heights, not the denser diagnostic grid or min–max height bytes. At 512, plate/girdle luma gap is 77.423, girdle/ground 20.145 and finish gap 0.37619. Forty-three legal variants pass 15 cases each; all 29 executable faults are rejected, including seven/nine valves, symmetric incisions, absent lap ramps, missing underface/girdle, sharp chevrons and tail-cap tone overrun. Both 32/512 maps are opaque M0 with positive Z and XYZ unit error ≤0.012027; 32 is coarse preview, not a per-valve certificate. Actual forced WebGPU/WebGL2 and strict-CSP dist native Worker/cache/borrowed-pool reuse/cleanup are exercised; no new Canvas2D, cross-browser or biological-material certification.

`leafstomata` depicts 25 schematic pairs of kidney-shaped guard cells with seeded size, position, orientation and pore-width variation around dark, recessed, occluded opaque pore floors. The two brighter, smoother cell crests meet at slightly lower polar contacts that remain above the leaf ground; this is not an undivided shell rim, toothed cowrie aperture or single coffee-bean groove. The actually read [Nadeau and Sack (2002), Stomatal Development in Arabidopsis](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3243354/), including its viewed Fig. 1 TEM/cryo-SEM, and [Jaafar and Anderson (2024), stomatal cell-wall review](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232514/), including its viewed Fig. 1 schematic, inform kidney-shaped eudicot guard cells joined at their poles rather than grass dumbbells. These are a reference chapter/review and their cited images, not experiments reproduced by the engine. The 0.00025 m tile, 5² layout and green palette are authored illustration, not colors measured from grayscale SEM, calibrated stomatal density or a species reconstruction. Existing compact squared shoulders and cached grain support C1 outer/pore shoulders, radial crests and polar contacts; the full pore skips the undefined radial coordinate. The constructor precomputes hashes, rotation/scale bases, inverse pore widths and 96² grain/12² skin noise. The field hot path has no allocation, hashing, square roots or trigonometry. Poses 1,200 B + grain 73,728 B + skin 1,152 B retain 76,080 B of typed storage, excluding JS containers/output maps and not proving higher fps. Default rotated support plus jitter has conservative half-width 0.448 < 0.5, requiring only its owner. Rough green ground abstracts the epidermis; it does not reconstruct pavement-cell topology, the developmental one-cell-spacing rule, organelles, geometric air passages, transmission/SSS, live opening, transpiration or biomechanics.

At three seeds the actual 512² height field has 25 hole-filled outer footprints, 25 four-connected recessed pores and 50 eight-connected cell crests. Eight-connectivity handles diagonal crest pixels; the polar-connected cells are not 50 separate meshes. Observed pore centroids/covariances independently recover principal axes: aspect ≥2.873, paired-crest midpoint offset ≤0.01213 cell and axial alignment error ≤0.11297. All 800 radial profiles per seed retain a closed raised enclosure; polar-profile peaks stand ≥0.32014 above the ground upper bound, with side-profile peaks ≥0.07780 higher than the polar peaks. Footprint radius CV ≥0.04282, relative pore-width CV ≥0.10597, position SD ≥0.04067 and orientation concentration ≤0.25534; changed-seed footprint classifications differ by 0.15845/0.16064, pore classifications by 0.04663/0.04932. C1 residual ≤0.000881 and signed UV difference ≤9.92e-16. Actual sampler heights classify the 512 RGBA phases: guard/ground luma gap 59.917, ground/pore 24.298, smoother-guard finish gap 0.31196 and guard/pore AO gap 0.64115. Optional height follows the shared min–max normalization, not raw height/relief values. Forty legal variants pass 15 cases each; all 25 executable faults are rejected. Both 32/512 maps are opaque M0 with positive Z and XYZ unit error ≤0.011043; 32 is coarse preview, not a per-pore/cell certificate. Actual forced WebGPU/WebGL2 and strict-CSP dist native Worker/cache/borrowed-pool reuse/cleanup are exercised; no new Canvas2D, cross-browser, biological or medical certification.

`watermelontourmaline` adds 16 separate, approximately rounded-triangular polished slices: pink cores, pale-gray transition zones and green rinds on one shared plane above rougher warm-gray backing. It is not fruit-rind striping, recolored cubic fluorite or engraved inlay. [GIA Tourmaline Quality Factors](https://www.gia.edu/tourmaline-quality-factor) describes a pink core/thin green skin and thin slices; its actually viewed typical specimen photo informs the palette. [GIA Micro-Features of Tourmaline (2024)](https://www.gia.edu/gems-gemology/summer-2024-micro-features-tourmaline) describes trigonal structure, triangular cross sections and color zoning. The 0.08 m tile, 4² layout and idealized threefold geometry are authored, not specimen/chemical/dimensional reconstruction. Existing fluorite/chiastolite planar-pigment principles and the fixed-gray neutral-pigment path are reused. Body, core and pale-zone boundaries use three compact-circle C1 products, not nearest-arc seams or a new public geometry/color API. Construction precomputes radius-normalized rotation bases, core/pale inverses and squares, hash, 96² grain and 8² cloud. The field hot path allocates nothing, uses no hash/sqrt/trig and skips inner layers/grain outside a slice. Pose 1,152 B + grain 73,728 B + cloud 512 B = 75,392 B retained typed storage, excluding JS containers/output maps and not implying an fps gain. Default support 0.34 + jitter 0.07 = 0.41 < 0.5 cell needs only the current owner. This is a front-lit opaque PBR palette approximation, without gem transmission/refraction, pleochroism, cat’s-eye/iris effect, inclusion optics, physical slice mesh or provenance/quality certification. No source photo is copied as an asset.

At three seeds the actual 512² sampler has 16 separate periodic four-connected slices. Height-weighted centroids and 96 first-exit rays independently measure normalized third Fourier coefficient ≥0.06576, second/fourth ≤0.00002564 and 120° difference ≤0.000514, without copying circles or private poses. All 1,536 rays per seed encounter pink, pale and green in order; sampled face height/relief span ≤0.001929, roughness span ≤0.01350 and backing/face roughness gap ≥0.59602. Radius CV ≥0.04427, position SD ≥0.03291, orientation concentration ≤0.23489; seed outline-classification change is 0.08276/0.07959. C1 residual ≤0.0001588, signed-UV difference ≤1.12e-16. Actual 512 RGBA pink/green/pale fractions are approximately 0.08293/0.07513/0.01218; pale luma exceeds both pigments by 46.305, phase mean heights differ by <0.618 byte and roughness by <0.00158. All 16 observed centers are red and all 1,536 rind probes green. Thirty-six legal variants each pass 15 cases; 24 executable faults are rejected. Swapping the palette leaves both pigment totals present but fails all 16 core-position checks. `cuttlebone` adds a warm-white, rough dielectric wall–septa section over dark, recessed, occluded opaque backing. The actually read [Yang et al. (2020) wall–septa study and Fig. 1](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7519314/), including its SEM/reconstruction images, provide the visual reference: cuttlebone is an internal shell, not vertebrate bone. The authored 0.0024 m nominal tile has six uneven layers and 24 staggered, oppositely bending, variable-amplitude quintic supports per layer, joined to septa by C1 product union—not a white recoloring of the continuous transverse medium in `cardboardedge`. This is a schematic 2D section; real 3D walls form a branching open labyrinth, so 144 2D windows do not mean 144 sealed chambers or the paper’s 93 vol% porosity. It does not reconstruct micro-CT, the 3D waviness gradient/growth direction, geometric holes, transmission/SSS, buoyancy, strength or biological dimensions. Nominal size and curves are authored choices, not copied measurements. Construction precomputes hash, layer bounds/inverse scales and 96² grain. The field hot path allocates no arrays/objects and uses no hash, sqrt or trig. Wall/layer arrays retain 2,456 B plus 73,728 B grain, totaling 76,184 B typed storage, excluding JS containers/output maps and not implying an fps gain. Default conservative support half-span is 0.45675 < 0.5 column; interface offset 0.12 < 0.5 needs at most one neighboring-row correction. Squared local tangent distance limits wall thinning; flat septa conceal row ownership changes.

At three seeds the actual 512² sampler has 144 periodic four-connected low regions and six layers, layer-height CV 0.07198–0.08107. Low-pixel fraction 0.88644–0.89196 describes only this 2D mask, not volume porosity. Every support has opposite-side lobes and a larger upper lobe; both bend directions occur, placement SD ≥0.09744 and amplitude CV ≥0.19434. Differentiating observed height-profile centroids and projecting FWHM onto the local normal gives within-wall max/min ≤1.0084 (bound 1.03), not certified global Euclidean distance. Chalk exceeds backing by ≥0.8570 color, ≥0.6525 height/relief and ≥0.7670 AO; backing roughness exceeds chalk by ≥0.1143. C1 residual ≤0.001774 and signed-UV difference ≤5.30e-14; actual 32/512 RGBA is M0, opaque, positive-Z with XYZ unit error ≤0.01252. Thirty legal variants each pass 15 cases; 21 valid faults are rejected, including max-union joints, linear shoulders, lost tangent correction, missing row correction and powder-only seed changes. Size 32 is a coarse preview, not certification of 144 windows. Forced WebGPU/WebGL2 gallery and strict-CSP dist native worker/cache/borrowed-pool reuse/cleanup were exercised; no broader Canvas2D, browser, geometry or biological-material certification is added.

`pallasite` adds an opaque polished-slice approximation: olive-to-honey dielectric crystals in a connected silver-gray metallic matrix, nearly coplanar phases and fine darker, slightly recessed, rougher intramineral fissures—not raised pebbles or cement grout. The actually read [NASA Mittlefehldt/Rumble abstract](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20060020744/downloads/20060020744.pdf) describes magnesian olivine mixed with iron-nickel, and [ASU’s Buseck Center](https://meteorites.asu.edu/stony-iron-meteorites/pallasites) describes greenish olivine; the [Esquel slice photo](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/Esquel.jpg) was viewed for crystal/reflective-metal morphology, not copied. This front-lit opaque authored PBR model does not provide the photo’s backlit transmission, refraction, gem quality, calibrated iron-nickel optical constants, etched Widmanstätten structure or origin/composition certification. The 0.16 m tile has 8² jittered periodic Voronoi grains, varying erosion and C1 half-plane products. A private `buildPeriodicVoronoiPlanes` directly reuses `septarian`’s clipping; its old inline copy is removed without adding a public geometry API. Clipping, hashing, square roots and trigonometry run only during construction; pixels inspect a 3² owner patch and surviving facets without allocating arrays/objects or rebuilding polygons, stopping at the first disjoint positive support. Across three sampled seeds each tile has 384 unit-plane triplets, four to eight facets per grain and mean six; retained typed storage including 96² grain is 88,064 B and shared construction scratch 1,608 B, excluding JS containers/output maps—not FPS. Seed changes crystal placement, size, tone and fissures. Grains M0/matrix M1 use the existing neutral-matrix pigment path; default metallic factor 1 preserves the mask, explicit 0 makes both dielectric. Four opaque maps, optional height, tint/repeats, sync/Worker/cache and ownership remain; no dependency, entry point, mesh, Canvas2D or cross-browser certification is added.

At three seeds the actual sampler’s 512² periodic four-connected mask has 64 separate grains, area CV 0.20349–0.22898 and maximum bbox aspect ≤1.582. Full-metal fraction is approximately 0.34326–0.35850, full-mineral 0.53615–0.54996. Mineral roughness exceeds metal by ≥0.09164, height/relief span ≤0.013985 (polished bound 0.04), AO 0.96–0.99. Comparing darkest/brightest pixels within each observed full-mineral component finds dark features in all 64 grains both more recessed and rougher, against an 80% bound, without private sites/planes. Seed classification changes approximately 0.33936/0.33960 of probes, color difference ≥0.6649; C1 residual ≤0.0005113 (bound 0.04), signed UV error ≤3.55e-14. Actual 512 RGBA has 64 mineral/one metal periodic four-connected components, M>250 fraction 0.35268, M<5 fraction 0.55801, mineral/matrix G−B gap 68.524, roughness gap 0.09162 and AO 245–252. At 32/512 XY² and XYZ length error are approximately 0.00003076, with positive Z and opaque pixels. The sampled polished preset’s 8-bit normals are nearly planar; tiny float fissure height is not presented as visible bump, and 32 does not certify 64 grains. Twenty-two legal variants pass all fifteen cases and twenty real faults are rejected, including geometry-frozen-but-still-colored seeds, reversed M phases, raised stones/deep grooves, dark fissures without recess/roughness, missing neighboring owners, nearest-edge/linear-shoulder creases and lost neutral metal pigment.

`gosperinlay` adds one slightly raised, smoother brass-toned metallic line over a rough navy dielectric backing. The [Gosper curve](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gosper_curve) page and its raw wikitext supply the 60° turtle, axiom A and both A/B productions. Three offline expansions give 343 equal links and 344 distinct triangular-lattice vertices, with two endpoints, no branches and no closing edge: a finite order-three pattern, not the limiting space-filling set or a Gosper-island tessellation. This differs from `moorecurve`’s 64-cell orthogonal closed groove, `boullebrassinlay`’s S-shaped foliate scrolls and `kintsugiceramic`’s crack network. Its 0.5 m preset stores a 343-character direction word. Construction builds four-value segments and 16² local bbox buckets; pixels do not interpret an L-system, allocate arrays/objects, scan all 343 links or use sqrt/trig/hash. It reuses `vogelspiral`’s in-place prefix-end indexing and `fiddleheads`’ product-union rounded joins: 801 references, 257 offsets, at most eleven candidates and a whole-tile mean of 3.12890625 per bin; typed storage including the 96² Float64 grain is 86,820 B, excluding JS strings/objects/output maps. These are structural counts, not FPS measurements. Squared capsule distance and C1 cubic shoulders retain round caps and flat cores. Seed affects grain finish only, not path placement or metal classification. Line M1/backing M0 needs a default material metallic factor of 1; explicit 0 makes both dielectric. Four opaque PBR maps, optional height and existing tint/repeats, sync/Worker/cache and ownership remain. No new entry point, dependency, mesh, alloy/conductivity/manufacturing simulation, Canvas2D or untested-browser certification.

An independent fixture recursively builds the public A/B grammar while production reads an offline direction word; it does not import private poses. Across three seeds the actual sampler yields 343 links and 344 reachable vertices from 949 candidate neighbor pairs: two degree-one endpoints, 342 degree-two interiors, no 606 shortcut links, no gaps at five interior probes per link and no metal in 686 lateral backing probes. Thirteen outward-half-plane first-exit rays per endpoint recover a half-height radius of approximately 0.00567186 and zero spread against a 1.5% bound. Core variation is ≤0.005958 (grain bound 0.0061), line/backing M1/M0, roughness gap ≥0.54555, color gap ≥0.82231 and AO gap 0.33. Seed changes color by ≥0.02365 and normalized height by ≤0.005742, leaving the metal mask identical. C1 residual is ≤0.0009104 (h=1e-10, bound 0.04), signed UV error ≤3.06e-16. At 512 the actual maps have M>250 fraction 0.13271, backing 0.82576, transition 0.044922, roughness gap 0.55991, luma gap 126 and height/metal mismatch at most three bytes (bound four). Outward normals on the raised line have dot ≥0.39413 (bound 0.08), XYZ length error ≤0.01240 and positive Z; line and backing each form one four-connected component. Size32 checks PBR contrast, registration and quantized normals, not 343-link/endpoint topology. Sixteen legal variants pass all fifteen cases; seventeen real faults are rejected, including max-union/linear-shoulder C1 residuals 1286.53/1155.58, an endpoint-only half-plane cutoff with centers retained (cap spread about 1), unclipped elliptical caps (0.0246952 spread), bbox-lost shoulders (9.968e9 residual), wrong direction/missing final link, overwide backing fill, lost roughness/relief, all-metal/all-dielectric output, unseeded grain and a seed-dependent radius change. Two separate RGBA source faults are also rejected by the same fixture: swapped X/Y preserves length but produces outward normal dot −0.54105, while forced Z255 stays forward-facing but produces XYZ length error 0.313756.

`vogelspiral` is a finite golden-angle panel of 97 equal flat glazed disks with rounded shoulders above rough gray backing, in teal/sage/ivory families of 33/32/32. The actually read [Vogel phyllotaxis section of Fermat’s spiral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fermat%27s_spiral#The_golden_ratio_and_the_golden_angle) gives r=c√n and θ=n×137.508°. This authored variant explicitly uses r=0.044√(n+0.5), θ=nπ(3−√5), n=0–96: the half-step radial offset avoids central crowding and is not the original n=0 center. These are discrete equal disks, not a continuous spiral, tangent growing-radius Doyle spirals, a plant simulation or certified Fibonacci arm counts. The nominal 0.5 m tile has UV radius 0.033 (nominally 16.5 mm); minimum center distance 0.06802551 exceeds diameter 0.066, with outer support radius 0.46523142 and clear margins, not an installation certification. Squared-radius shoulders are C1; seeds vary tone/grain only. As with existing bounded neighboring-shape queries, an 8 × 8 CSR table stores 224 references, at most 8/average 3.5 candidates per bucket instead of 97 per-pixel tests. Fixed storage is 291+96² Float64 entries and 65+224 Uint16 entries: 76,634 B excluding JS objects/output maps. Trig/sqrt/hashes run only at initialization; sampling allocates nothing and bypasses generic detail. Periodic signed UVs, opaque dielectric M0, four maps plus optional height and existing ownership remain unchanged.

Across three seeds the actual sampler’s 1024² connected-face raster has 97 disks, without reading private pose tables. Sorting observed centers by r² recovers golden divergence with error ≤0.00151271 rad (limit 0.006) and affine-r² residual ≤0.023898 annuli (limit 0.06); equal-radius spread is ≤0.32044%, eccentricity ≤0.004744. Thirteen first-exit rays give radius range ≤0.50264% (limit 1.5%); all 97 centers are filled, core-height variation ≤0.005125 within the 0.0061 grain bound, and closest-disk midpoints are flat grout, rejecting annuli and domes. Actual 512 height maps also have 97 faces; 32 does not certify all 97/complete circle geometry. C1 residual ≤0.00014433 (h=1e-10, limit 0.04), signed-UV error ≤6.11e-16. Nineteen legal variants pass all fifteen cases, including rotation, reflection, radial offset and 4/12 bins. Seventeen faults are rejected: non-affine-r² residual 2.32301, ellipses with expanded cache bounds have 5.0948% roundness error, annuli have zero filled centers, domes have core variation 0.06735, shoulder-omitting cache bounds cause a C1 jump near 8.96e9, linear shoulders 343.17. Seeds change glaze/grain, not whole-panel rotation; candidate counts are not an FPS claim.

`langtonsant` is an authored 1,024-step Langton-ant snapshot: 122 glossy dark logical-black cells on a rough pale-warm 32 × 32 tiled board, with a raised cream triangle marking the final cell/heading. The actually read [MathWorld Langton’s Ant](https://mathworld.wolfram.com/LangtonsAnt.html) convention turns left 90° on white, right 90° on black, flips the departed cell and advances one unit; do not mix it with the mirrored convention. Starting at (16,16) facing up on an all-white unbounded plane, this offline trajectory ends at (8,8) facing down, with 122 black/226 visited cells. Its entire x=5–24, y=6–22 trajectory stays inside the 32-cell frame. Runtime stores only 32 row bitmaps and the final direction vector, not a simulator or copied image. The nominal 0.32 m tile has 0.01 m cells. Rounded square shoulders and a product of three half-plane ramps keep the compass triangle C1; logical white is rendered pale warm rather than pure white. It is not a QR code, interactive automaton or proof of a 104-step highway/infinite evolution. Each sampler retains one 96² Float64 grain lattice (73,728 B typed storage, excluding JS data/output maps), with O(1) bitmap lookup, allocation-free sampling, no repeated hashes and generic detail bypassed. Periodic signed UVs, opaque dielectric M0, four maps plus optional height and existing ownership remain unchanged.

Tests copy no bitmap and do not compare against the same forward algorithm: actual sampler/512 RGBA cells, the exposed (.34,.34) compass-cell corner and the triangle’s wide-back/narrow-front heading reverse through 1,024 steps to the unique initially white north-facing origin. At 512 there are 123 half-height components (122 black squares plus a triangle on a white cell). At 32 the binary cell-center snapshot survives, but a one-pixel compass cannot reveal its heading/covered bit: the unique inverse among two bit/four heading candidates is checked, not complete shoulders/triangle geometry. Across three seeds axis-span mismatch is ≤0.01977% (limit 1%), normalized C1 residual ≤0.0002472 (h=1e-10, limit 0.04), signed-UV error ≤6.67e-16. Fifteen legal variants pass all fifteen cases; seventeen faults are rejected, including a wrong bit, wrong marker cell/heading, mirrored turn convention, reversed bits/transposition, circular/stretched cells, linear shoulders, ignored seed, seed-shifted geometry and metallic ink. Compass-only linear shoulders measure 659.38; stretched-cell span mismatch is 14.8268%. Seeds vary finish, never the board.

`pentominotiles` packs each of the twelve free pentominoes once into an authored 6 × 10 rectangle, then repeats it 5 × 3 into 30 × 30 cells and 180 glazed pieces. A pentomino is five edge-connected equal squares, with rotations/reflections identified; the actually read [Pentomino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pentomino) reference explains the twelve free shapes, 63 fixed orientations and 6 × 10 packing. The layout was solved and checked offline, not copied from an image; A–L are private authored IDs, not conventional letter names. Navy, slate and ivory families have 60 pieces each above rough gray grout. The nominal 0.6 m tile has 0.02 m cells. Smooth neighboring-cell weights merge by whole-piece ID, removing fake internal grid seams; competing IDs tie only inside flat grout, preserving C1 rounded shoulders at concavities and four-cell junctions. This weighted rounding is not an exact geometric offset, installation specification, interactive puzzle or general solver. Initialization retains 900 Uint16 owners, 180 Float64 tones and a 96² Float64 grain lattice: 76,968 B of fixed typed-array storage, excluding JS objects/temporaries/output maps. Sampling allocates nothing, rebuilds no hashes/solver and bypasses generic detail. Periodic signed UVs, opaque dielectric M0, four maps plus optional height and existing ownership remain unchanged.

`pythagorastree` adds four finite glazed-square trees, each with 31 squares (root plus four generations, counts 1/2/4/8/16), fading from red-brown trunks to ivory leaf squares over rough grout. Unlike existing `pythagoreantiles`, it is not a plane-filling 2:1 two-size tiling with five large/five small squares. [Wikipedia Pythagoras tree](<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pythagoras_tree_(fractal)>) and [MathWorld](https://mathworld.wolfram.com/PythagorasTree.html) describe child squares on the legs of an outward isosceles right triangle: child side √2/2 of the parent, child nominal areas summing to parent area. Infinite trees can overlap; area with multiplicity is not generally union area. Exact dyadic-coordinate separating axes verify this authored finite 31-square construction has no interior overlap, 46 nominal corner/edge contacts and root-equivalent area in each generation. Its finite bounds are 4.5L × 3.25L, not the infinite tree's 6L × 4L. Four motifs, scale 0.2, centerY 1.625, grout 0.002, shoulder 0.003, roughness 0.3, UV relief 0.012, palette 100,32,30 / 240,221,180 and nominal tile 0.4 m are authored settings. Thirty-one seven-value geometric records, 124 tones and 96² grain total 76,456 B of Float64 tables, plus JS scalars/initialization recursion, not total RAM. Each point examines one owner's 31 squares with squared-radius rejection and two separable squared C1 profiles, without per-point allocation, hashing, trigonometry, square roots or neighboring-owner scans. Empty grout skips grain; generic detail is skipped. Four opaque dielectric maps, metallic 0, optional height and existing factory/Worker/cache/ownership remain unchanged. No infinite fractal, actual tree, complete mesh, fractal-dimension or tile/structural/installation certification is supplied.

`ichinghexagrams` adds an 8 × 8 sheet of six-line relief figures: flat charcoal-green bars with rounded shoulders on rough cream backing, connected yang lines and equally split yin lines with open centers. The sheet has 192 yang and 192 yin lines, hence 576 disconnected bars. The actually read [Hexagram (I Ching)](<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hexagram_(I_Ching)>) introduction describes six stacked lines, solid yang/broken yin, counting from the bottom, and multiple sequences. This preset uses authored row-major binary order 0–63, least-significant bit at the bottom, not King Wen, Unicode codepoint order or certified Fu Xi arrangement. It differs from seven-segment digits, EAN-13 bars, Braille domes and Rule30 evolving cells. Each point selects one glyph's nearest row and multiplies separable C1 profiles using cached squared radii and inverse bands, without per-point allocation, hashing, trigonometry, square roots or neighboring-glyph scans. Generic detail is skipped. Four opaque dielectric maps, metallic/mortar 0, optional height and existing factory/Worker/cache/ownership remain unchanged. No font, interactive text, transparent holes, meshes, divination or historical/cultural certification is supplied.

`apollonianmosaic` adds a finite two-round Descartes-reflection glazed-circle mosaic: dark teal, sage and ivory disks recursively fill tangent gaps around three equal initial circles, with nineteen disks in each of four periodic motifs. Unlike equal staggered `pennyround`, concentric sector `circularpavers` or square-hole Sierpinski patterns, the disks form an unequal tangent-circle packing. [Apollonian gasket](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollonian_gasket) supplies recursive tangency; [Descartes's theorem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Descartes%27s_theorem) supplies signed bends and the complex center equation. From the quadratic roots, the authored implementation derives b′ = 2Σ(other b) − b and (bz)′ = 2Σ(other bz) − bz, starting with a negative enclosing circle and three equal inner circles. Reflections cannot immediately backtrack; the quad is restored after recursion instead of copied per branch. R 0.47, initial radius R(2√3−3), 2 × 2 motifs, depth 2, grout 0.0015, shoulder 0.003, roughness 0.3, relief 0.012, palette 28,68,62 / 236,218,170 and nominal tile 0.24 m are authored settings; the enclosing circle is not drawn as a tile. Nineteen four-value disk records, 76 tones and 96² grain total 74,944 B of Float64 tables, plus three JS tone numbers and initialization scratch, not total RAM. Sampling reads nineteen disks of one owner using cached squared radii and inverse shoulder bands for C1 bevels, without per-point allocation, hashing, trigonometry or square roots. Empty grout skips grain; generic detail is skipped. Four opaque dielectric maps, optional height and existing Worker/cache/ownership remain unchanged. This is a finite motif of flat bevelled disks, not an infinite fractal, domed mesh, transparency, certified fractal dimension or real mosaic installation.

[Wikipedia's Prismatic pentagonal tiling section](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elongated_triangular_tiling#Prismatic_pentagonal_tiling) supplies the dual relationship, three 120° plus two 90° angles, cmm symmetry and parallel lines bisecting stretched hexagons, but no coordinates. Four alternating houses form a 1 × (2+√3) cell; 15 × 4 cells contain 240 faces.
